## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.
*Example: "I struggle to benchmark my numeric keypad speed because there is no dedicated numpad mode."*

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe how you imagine this feature working, including any UI or engine behavior changes.

## 🎨 Design or UX Inspiration
If you have mockups, references (e.g., Monkeytype, Keybr), or screenshots, please include them here.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, considerations, or edge cases about the feature request here.
